Excalidraw Projects — UI design

Flow: Dashboard (projects) → Project page (designs) → Editor (stock Excalidraw + our breadcrumb + 'Designs' sidebar).

Every token, radius, shadow and control size is lifted from Excalidraw's own theme.scss / component styles, so the dashboard reads as part of the editor. Dark mode is the same markup with Excalidraw's dark tokens.
Editor: Excalidraw's own UI is untouched. We only add the top-right breadcrumb island + 'Designs' trigger (renderTopRightUI) and a custom <Sidebar> listing the project's designs.
